auth.name: Your name
auth.signInFailed: That email and password did not work.
auth.setupIntro: Create the owner account. This works once: after that, sign-up is closed and only this account can sign in.
auth.setupTokenHint: The SETUP_TOKEN secret you set when deploying.
auth.ssoRefused: Single sign-on was refused. Use the account whose verified email matches the Talvuno owner.
auth.ssoUnavailable: Single sign-on could not start. Try again, or use your email and password.

notes.foregroundCalls: Calls only ring while Talvuno is open in the foreground. A phone that is locked, or a tab in the background, may not ring. Missed calls show up in Recents.

push.title: Notifications
push.intro: Get a notice on this device when you miss a call or a new message arrives while Talvuno is closed.
push.closedAppLimit: A closed app cannot ring for a call. Notices tell you about a missed call after it happened.
push.iosNeedsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, add Talvuno to your Home Screen first, then open it from there and come back to this page. Safari only allows notifications for installed apps.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications for web apps.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for Talvuno. Allow them in your browser or system settings, then reload this page.
push.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
push.disabled: Notifications are off for this device.
push.testSent: Test sent. It should arrive in a moment.
push.testNone: Nothing was sent. Turn notifications off and on again on this device.

error.denied: Permission was not given, so notifications stay off.
error.not_configured: This Talvuno has no Web Push keys yet. The owner needs to set them up first.
error.unsupported: This browser cannot receive notifications here.

install.title: Install Talvuno
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
install.iosStep3: Open Talvuno from your Home Screen.
install.other: Use your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.

update.available: A new version of Talvuno is ready.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.name: Name
contacts.numberHint: Start with + and the country code.
contacts.label: Label

banner.noNumbers: Add a phone number to start calling and texting.
banner.noCountries: Choose which countries you may call and text. Until you do, nothing can be sent.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.intro: The Twilio numbers on your account. Sync reads them from Twilio.
numbers.empty: No numbers yet. Sync to load the numbers on your Twilio account.
numbers.name: Name
numbers.connectWarning: This replaces whatever {{number}} pointed at before. Incoming calls and texts will come to Talvuno instead, and any TwiML App on the number is cleared. The previous settings are saved so you can restore them.
numbers.connected: Connected. Calls now go to {{voice}} and texts to {{sms}}.
numbers.alreadyConnected: This number already points at Talvuno. Nothing was changed.
numbers.restoreWarning: This puts the saved settings back: calls to {{voice}} and texts to {{sms}}. Talvuno will stop receiving this number's calls and texts.
numbers.restored: The previous settings are back on the number.
numbers.removeWarning: This removes the number from Talvuno only. Your history stays, and the number stays on your Twilio account.
numbers.addedBack: The number is back in Talvuno.

safety.title: Calling and texting safety
safety.intro: Talvuno only calls or texts countries on this list, and stops at the hourly limits.
safety.noneAllowed: No countries are allowed yet, so nothing can be sent.
safety.limitsInvalid: Limits must be whole numbers: texts 0 to 10000, calls 0 to 1000.

account.title: Account
account.notConfigured: Twilio is not set up on this deployment yet.

check.title: Setup check
check.intro: Which settings this deployment has. Values are never shown.
check.failed: Twilio did not accept the connection: {{error}}

messages.title: Messages
messages.empty: No conversations yet. Texts you send or receive show up here.
messages.selectThread: Pick a conversation to read it.
messages.tooLong: Messages can be at most {{max}} characters.
messages.attachmentDetail_one: {{count}} attachment arrived ({{types}}). It was not saved.
messages.attachmentDetail_other: {{count}} attachments arrived ({{types}}). They were not saved.
messages.invalidNumber: That is not a valid phone number.
messages.noNumbers: Add a Twilio number in Settings before sending messages.
messages.a2pNote: Texting US recipients from a US number needs A2P 10DLC registration in Twilio. Without it, carriers may block your messages.

voice.noNumbers: Add a phone number in Settings before you make calls.
voice.incomplete: Keep typing, or start with + and the country code.

device.ready: Ready to call and receive calls
device.error: Calling is not available right now

errors.token: Your calling session expired. Select Retry to connect calling again.
errors.credentials: Twilio did not accept this deployment's calling credentials. Check the API key and TwiML App in Settings, Setup check.
errors.setup: Calling could not connect. Check your internet connection, then select Retry.
errors.micDenied: Talvuno cannot use your microphone. Allow microphone access for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
errors.micUnavailable: No microphone was found. Connect one and try again.
errors.unreachable: That number could not be reached.
errors.network: The connection dropped. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.media: This browser could not open an audio connection for the call, so Talvuno ended it. A firewall, a network that blocks WebRTC, or a browser setting or extension that limits WebRTC can cause this. Allow WebRTC for this site, or try another network or browser.
errors.webrtcBlocked: This browser could not open an audio connection (WebRTC), not even through a relay server, so the call was not placed. A firewall, a network that blocks WebRTC, or a browser setting or extension that limits it can cause this. Allow WebRTC for this site, or try another network or browser.
errors.notSetUp: Calling is not set up yet. Check the Twilio setup in Settings.
errors.rateLimited: Too many call attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: The call did not go through. Try again.
errors.geoPermission: Twilio blocks calls to this country on your account. Allow it under Voice Geo Permissions in the Twilio console.
errors.invalidNumber: Twilio says that is not a valid number.
errors.unknownNumberFormat: Twilio does not recognise the format of that number.
errors.callBlocked: Twilio blocked this call (fraud risk or regulation for the destination). Check the call log in the Twilio console.
errors.callerIdNotOwned: Twilio does not accept this caller ID. It must be a number you own or have verified.
errors.callFailed: Twilio could not connect the call (error {{code}}).
errors.answerNeedsCalling: Calling is not ready yet. Wait a moment or select Retry.

routing.defaultGreeting: Sorry, no one can take your call right now. Please leave a message after the beep.

hours.title: Business hours and do not disturb
hours.intro: Outside these hours, or while do not disturb is on, calls go straight to voicemail. Nothing rings and no notice is sent.
hours.dndOn: Do not disturb is on. Calls go straight to voicemail.
hours.invalid: Each closing time must be after its opening time.

voicemail.title: Voicemail and ring time
voicemail.intro: How long a call rings before it goes to voicemail, and what the caller hears first.
voicemail.greetingHint: Leave it empty to use the default greeting.

blocked.title: Blocked numbers
blocked.intro: Blocked callers are turned away before anything rings and never show as missed. Texts from blocked senders are not saved, shown or notified.
